text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, with the Tenno Sho (Spring) fast approaching—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(...The next race is the Tenno Sho (Spring).
If it goes according to "memory,"
it should be the race where Bright shines, but――)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (...Well, based on how things have gone, it probably won't be exactly the same.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder how things will turn out.
Found you, Stego-san!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Fukukitaru, huh?
You're full of energy today too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Stego-san! This time for sure!
This time, race against me!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —At the Tenno Sho (Spring)!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Allow me to show you! The victor of the Kikuka Sho! Riding a sky-high wave of good fortune! My super-fortune-summoning run!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Are you running in it?
In this year's Tenno Sho (Spring)?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course~! Ever since I watched
Ms. Stego and Ms. Suzuka's race,
I've felt in peak condition non-stop!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is practically a revenge match of sorts!!
The plan is to repay Ste-Go-san with my peak condition!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Haha—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(This girl...
When did her presence become so overwhelming—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...All right, Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: We'll settle the score for real in the Tenno Sho (Spring). I'll make up for the Kikuka Sho right then and there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Let's settle it with that!
Who is the true Fortune-Invoking King among our peers!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Wahahaha. What on earth is that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Lady McQueen, whom will you be supporting today: Lady Bright or Lady Stego?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...The wish Bright hopes to fulfill with today's victory.
As a fellow Mejiro horse girl,
it is something to be deeply respected."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, just this once...
I choose to believe in Bright's blooming.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...This is strictly my personal policy
as an Umamusume of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So please, do not mind me,
and pray for whatever your heart desires.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...!
Understood...!

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Lady Stego......
Please...... seize glory in your hands......!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After finishing her preparations to race, Stay Gold
shared a conversation she had previously had with
Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...It's true that I also ran
in the Tenno Sho (Spring) with Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: But this wasn't supposed to be the race where Bright becomes the aurora.
choice_data_list: And yet today, she's about to race in top condition.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Much to my delight.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, it looks like I'll be able to compete with the aurora
I couldn't see firsthand at the Kikuka Sho in this lifetime after all...!
choice_data_list: A long-distance showdown with your peers...!
A long-distance showdown with your peers...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
As a stayer,
I haven't had the chance to compete against them
in a GⅠ until now.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: After all the training I did with McQueen, how well can I match up against them at long distance...? Just thinking about it—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha...!
I'm getting excited...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
All right. Guess it's time to head out.
Into my very first storm on the pathless road.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-nyaka~♪ Han-nyaka~♪
Hum-nyaka hum-hum♪ Nya-ka-ka~♪

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well, well, look who's in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(And on top of that, what incredible conditioning.
Vitality is bursting from her whole body...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this amazing, Stego-san?!
If I do say so myself, I'm at peak condition of peak conditions!!
My luck is 100 out of 100 percent!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just for today, victory will be mine!
I don't feel like I can lose to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's what matters most.
However—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You're not the only one
who has no intention of losing to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh, ohhh...!?
W-What is with that... unbelievable aura...!?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(...The whole place was swallowed up in an instant.
Like being overwhelmed by a colossal mountain—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Lady Stego.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As a Mejiro umamusume, with the pride
of one who runs long distances in my heart—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I must deliver it.
Spring to the Mejiro family once more. The glory of the Tenno Sho Shield. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Across this longest distance, with pride, to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-What an intimidating presence...!
But I'm not backing down today either~~!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Nice.
That's the side of you I wanted to run with today.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Which one of us
is the strongest at this maximum distance?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It's time for the decisive battle.
